NATURE DESK – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND50

The NATURE DESK – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND50 is the perfect blend of sustainability, craftsmanship and modern corporate gifting needs. Specially curated for companies committed to green initiatives, this eco-conscious gift set is designed to inspire productivity while promoting environmental responsibility. Made using responsibly sourced materials like cork, bamboo, wood and plantable seed paper, this eco-friendly desk combo reflects the true spirit of sustainable corporate gifting.

Whether you are looking for premium eco-friendly corporate gifts, sustainable onboarding kits, or green promotional gifts, the ND50 gift set stands out with its unique combination of utility and nature-friendly components. Each product within this set is designed to reduce waste and encourage a more mindful lifestyle — making it an ideal choice for employee welcome kits, festive gifting, client appreciation, and brand promotions.

Complete Components of the NATURE DESK ND50 Gift Set

This eco-friendly gift set includes a thoughtful collection of practical stationery and reusable desk accessories, all crafted to offer a greener alternative to traditional corporate gifts. The components include:

  • Cork Sticky Notes – A biodegradable and renewable alternative to regular sticky pads.
  • Tree Bark Cork Coaster – A durable, stylish and sustainable coaster made from natural cork.
  • 5 Plantable Paper Pen Set – Eco pens infused with seeds that grow into plants after disposal.
  • 5 Plantable Seed Pencil Set – Seed pencils designed to encourage a zero-waste writing experience.
  • Plantable Calendar in Tin Box – A reusable tin-case calendar printed on seed paper that grows when planted.
  • Plantable Diary B6 (Perfect) – A beautifully crafted seed-paper diary that can be planted after use.
  • Forest Grove Station Bamboo Bottle – 450ml – A premium-quality reusable bamboo bottle that replaces plastic.
  • Large Wooden Desk Organizer with Drawer – A spacious, elegant, and eco-friendly desk organizer for professionals.

Why Choose the Nature Desk Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

In today’s sustainability-driven world, eco-friendly gift sets like the ND50 play a vital role in enhancing your company’s green values. This premium set aligns with CSR goals, supports a plastic-free lifestyle, and promotes eco-conscious work habits. Every item included contributes to reducing the environmental footprint while offering real day-to-day functionality.

Companies increasingly prefer sustainable corporate gifts that reflect long-term environmental commitment. The NATURE DESK – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND50 fits perfectly into modern gifting trends, helping businesses strengthen brand image while providing employees and clients with meaningful, reusable, and plant-based products.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Made from natural, reusable, and biodegradable materials.
  • Perfect for corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, festive gifts, and promotional giveaways.
  • Encourages zero-waste and eco-conscious habits in the workplace.
  • Includes high-utility items suitable for daily professional use.
  • Plantable stationery encourages green living and environmental awareness.
  • Beautifully packaged for a premium gifting experience.

Ideal For

  • Corporate gifts and sustainable gifting programs
  • Employee joining kits and HR onboarding kits
  • Eco-friendly promotional giveaways
  • Festive and seasonal gifting
  • Client appreciation gifts

With thoughtfully curated elements and an emphasis on sustainability, the NATURE DESK – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | ND50 is an excellent choice for brands looking to make a positive environmental impact through their gifting strategy. Promote sustainability, support green values, and inspire eco-conscious habits — all with one beautifully crafted gift set.
